extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, researchers, agency staff, and notice-and-comment participants seeking authoritative information on U.S. federal agencies
extracted.subtask_description: A machine-readable directory (JSON) of U.S. federal agencies containing agency names, IDs, descriptions, URLs, logos, and links to recent Federal Register documents; useful for locating the responsible agency for a rulemaking or notice-and-comment action.
